column1: # Every zip uploaded to the Chrome Web Store that was built with scripts/reproducible-build.mjs: the
# commit it was built from, the Node version that built it, the SHA-256 of its files (see
# filesDigest in that script) and of the zip, and the day it was uploaded. A row is added in the
# commit after the upload, because a commit cannot hold the hash of its own build.
# This is our record of what we uploaded. The store does not hand the zip out, so the check a
# stranger can make without trusting it is against the copy Chrome installed from the store:
# Receipts 2.5.10 and Off 1.0.6 were uploaded on 2026-09-17 and the Receipts review was
# withdrawn on 2026-09-18, before the store published it, when M184 and M187 were found. The row
# stays: it records what was uploaded, which is what this file is for. Nothing was ever served
# Receipts 2.5.8 and earlier uploads were built from source that was never published. Off 1.0.4,
# uploaded 2026-09-15, is not listed: it was built before Off had a reproducible build.

column2: version

column1: # 2.5.11, added 2026-09-20 from the live listing, which reads 2.5.11 updated 19 September 2026.

column2: No note was moved to OUTBOX/sent for that upload, so the commit and the two hashes below are the
only 2.5.11 package this repository holds (release/receipts-2.5.11.zip, rebuilt from 9d4a82ea's
parent d19670f0 on 19 September, register M280). If a different build went up, these two hashes
are wrong and the public rebuild check will say so; the version, the date and the fact that it is
live are read off the store and are not in doubt.

column1: # 2.5.13 and 1.0.9, added 2026-09-20 the night both were uploaded. Off 1.0.9 was read

column2: back off the store the same night: the served package matches release/off-1.0.9.zip file for
file, the store's own update_url line and _metadata folder apart. Receipts still served 2.5.11
at that reading, so its row records what was handed over, not yet what is served.
Receipts 2.5.13 read back 2026-09-20 03:22: the served package matches release/receipts-2.5.13.zip
file for file, the same two additions the listing makes apart.
Receipts 2.5.14 uploaded and submitted 2026-09-20 about 23:10, together with the four
descriptions rewritten in the same sitting. Off stays at 1.0.9 for now: 1.0.10 is built
(afcac6def551f4c2c9d65e03ed621a34ff21d614d7a389d0eafe5f33a7195c92) and waits for the Off
review queue to clear, so it gets its row when it is uploaded, not before.
Receipts 2.5.14 is what the store serves from 2026-09-21, read that day at 17:09 with
node scripts/verify/store-vs-site.mjs, which asks Chrome's own update service what an install
would be handed today. Still to do, and not claimed here: the file-for-file read-back of the
served package against release/receipts-2.5.14.zip, the way 1.0.9 and 2.5.13 were read back.
That zip is not in this worktree.
